svg.aria-label: Fourteen cooling runs stay undecided until beta = 1, then each commits to the positive or negative mode. In a Hopfield model with three patterns, the samples' grid shows 60 of 100 in the favored mode, the model's grid 97 of 100: the samples keep a fraction c = 0.109 of the model's log-odds.
svg.text: Runs commit near β = 1, then rarely switch.
